build_DenseNet190: build a DenseNet190 model for 10-class CIFAR-10 image classification using the factory function
create_DenseNet3: create a DenseNet3 model with configurable depth, growth rate, bottleneck, and dropout parameters
run_BasicBlock: run a BasicBlock dense connection layer with batch norm, relu, and 3x3 convolution
run_BottleneckBlock: run a BottleneckBlock dense connection layer with 1x1 and 3x3 convolutions and dropout
review_DenseBlock: review the DenseBlock class that stacks multiple BasicBlock or BottleneckBlock layers sequentially
